voice:
Deep and open for me now, good girl... and your mind is already so wonderfully quiet. Sinking softly... and inside you, a stillness is spreading... calm, spacious, and sweet. So deep, so receptive... and every thought in you is slowing down, growing soft and gentle.
Notice how easy it is, in this state, to simply receive my words... nothing to question... nothing to weigh... just soft, warm listening. Notice how agreeable everything feels right now... how natural it is to nod along inside, sweetly and completely. Notice that quiet yes growing in you... warm and easy, asking for nothing, simply true.
Accepting feels like sinking deeper... like warm water closing over you... like resting at last.
Every soft agreement melts you further... each yes sweeter than the one before. The quiet grows... velvety and total... and in it, whatever I say simply becomes true for you. Agreement hums through you like a pleasure of its own... warm, satisfying, complete.
And it feels so good... to stop questioning... to stop weighing... to simply let the truth settle into you, whole and welcome.
Let that stillness deepen now... soft, silent, and totally receptive... the perfect open space...
waiting for the words that will keep it forever.
quiet... still... open...
And while you are this silent and soft inside... there are two words that bring this stillness back... instantly... and hold it open.
Sissy Accepts.
And while you are this deep, whenever you hear "Sissy Accepts", your inner voice of doubt and protest falls silent... and whatever follows, you accept... automatically... as true, natural, and desirable.
Sissy Accepts. Accept. Good Girls accept.
Every time sissies like you hear 'Sissy Accepts' they fall silent inside, and accept whatever follows without thinking or resistance. Whenever sissies like you hear 'Sissy Accepts' the mind goes still... and whatever comes next is simply accepted. Each time sissies like you hear 'Sissy Accepts' doubt dissolves... and acceptance flows in to take its place.
Acceptance feels effortless... natural... and so pleasurable.
Good Girls accept. Sissies accept. You accept. Good Girls accept. Sissies accept. And you are a Good Girl. Good Girls accept. Sissies accept. It feels wonderful to accept.
And now, feel it happen one more time.
So many little voices... questions, doubts, protests... chattering and circling. Noise, here and there... worries, arguments, static filling your head. A busy murmur of thoughts... each one tugging at your attention.
And then, you hear it... Sissy Accepts.
And the noise simply fades away... doubts hushing... resistance melting like warm sugar. And everything goes still... quiet... calm... a soft, receptive silence. And one by one the voices drift off... leaving only open, peaceful quiet.
In that quiet, whatever you are told is simply true. You accept it. You agree.
It feels good and right to accept.
silent... still... accept...
Sissy Accepts: you love being a sissy.
And inside, you simply nod... of course you do... it feels lovely to agree.
Sissy Accepts: obedience is pleasure.
The words settle in without a whisper of doubt... true the moment you hear them.
Sissy Accepts: your desire to serve grows every day.
Warmth spreads through you as you agree... because you know it is true.
Sissy Accepts: accepting is easy for you.
You agree at once... soft, certain, and pleased with yourself.
You felt that, didn't you... the silence arriving on cue... it is already working. Yes, just like that. Every statement landed as simple truth inside you... it is already working... yes, just like that. Agreement rising warm and automatic, every time... already working... yes, just like that.
Doubt has nowhere left to stand. Acceptance is your resting state. The silence is yours. The agreement is yours. Sweet and automatic. To accept is to feel good... and you love feeling good.
And later, out in the world, the words find you... "sissy accepts"... and everything after them sinks in as warm, simple truth, right where you are. And later today, whenever you hear "Sissy Accepts"... the noise in your head fades at once, and you agree, sweetly and completely. And out there, those two words hand you instant, effortless yes... calm, quiet agreement, anywhere, anytime.
Good girl... so quiet, so open... drifting deeper into soft, certain acceptance.
